## Key Insights All three share the same shape: a real production change (a new PROCESS_FACT_REGISTRY entry, a newly-required review_pass_set argument, and a new done_recover version-bump wiring) outran a test fixture's synthetic setup, and none of the three fixtures are registered in lattice.config.json's validate.commands, so lattice validate silently never runs them -- only the broader root npm test does. Each failure's root cause was independently confirmed by direct reproduction on the current main tree before this story was opened.

## Solution Tradeoffs Bundling all three into one story trades focused single-root-cause REVIEW lanes for saving three separate story lifecycle overheads (each full INIT-to-DONE cycle carries meaningful fixed cost, as observed directly in B-a7c5). Per explicit user instruction, each bug gets an independent RED reproduction (repro-first methodology under packages/main/tests/red/) proven to fail before any fix lands, then a GREEN fix, before the story advances past DEV.

Fix three silently-failing test fixtures not covered by validate.commands (acceptance-basis, review_pass_set readManifest, done_recover version-bump)

Three pre-existing fixtures under packages/main/src/tasks/ fail deterministically on a clean, untouched main checkout, but none are registered in lattice.config.json's validate.commands, so lattice validate never surfaces them -- only the broader root `npm test` (full-suite-runner.js) does. All three were discovered incidentally during B-a7c5's work (2026-08-15) while running npm test for extra confidence beyond lattice validate, and confirmed reproducible on a clean untouched main checkout at commit 8dbfac8809 before being deliberately kept out of that story's scope. 1) proofstory-acceptance-basis-smoke.ts: deriveAcceptanceCoverageBasis's plannedBeforeCode assertion expects status 'complete' but gets 'partial'. Root cause confirmed by direct repro: PROCESS_FACT_REGISTRY (process-fact-registry.ts) grew a new entry `artifact:acceptance-rollout-report.json` whose producerSourceRefs include packages/main/src/core/acceptance-rollout.ts and scripts/run-proofstory-acceptance-rollout-cohort.mjs alongside handlers/proofstory.ts. Because buildBoundedSourceGraph (acceptance-discovery-adapters.ts:1092) pulls ALL of a registry entry's source refs into the required snapshot closure once handlers/proofstory.ts is relevant, and the fixture's synthetic pureRoot workspace (built by writeCanonicalAcceptanceRegistration) never stubs the two new files, they show up as snapshot_missing blind spots -- a fixture staleness bug, not a production logic bug. 2) field-regression-cli-smoke.ts: assertReviewRunStartCliSurface calls review_pass_set without --readManifest, which command-catalog.ts now marks required. The real CLI error is 'Argument validation failed: readManifest: Invalid input: expected object, received undefined', but the fixture's own assertion expects a completely different message pattern (/already stale|stale/i), so it fails on a message mismatch instead of ever exercising the staleness scenario it was written to test. 3) worktree-authority-smoke.ts: assertDoneRecoverRunsPostMergeBuildForRuntimeChanges's done_recover call throws 'DONE post-merge version bump failed before any commit: ENOENT ... package.json' from core/version-bump.ts's bumpVersionOnDoneMerge (called via handlers/done-recover.ts). The DONE-merge auto-bump feature now wires bumpVersionOnDoneMerge into done_recover's post-merge path, requiring root/package.json (and the other version sync points) to exist, but this fixture's synthetic mkdtemp root was never given one since that requirement postdates the fixture. Per explicit user direction: prove each with a RED reproduction first (repro-first methodology, tests/red/), then fix to GREEN, all under one story driven to DONE.
